scope: Production pure C# model invariants and save persistence; synthetic fixed-load longitudinal bench is diagnostic only; excludes Unity/PhysX and Android validation

checks.Name: configuration/default vehicle has valid finite SI parameters
configuration/nonphysical mass and NaN values are rejected
configuration/torque curve must be strictly ordered
configuration/independent defaults do not share mutable tuning
steering/straight ahead produces zero wheel angles
steering/right wheel is inside a right turn
steering/left and right turns are mirrored
steering/Ackermann wheel axes share the same turn centre
tires/free rolling produces no propulsive or lateral force
tires/stationary contact does not create energy
tires/wheelspin drives forward and reverse with correct sign
tires/locked wheel dissipates forward and reverse translation
tires/lateral force opposes sideslip in either travel direction
tires/combined grip circle holds over load and slip sweep
tires/load sensitivity reduces coefficient as wheel load increases
tires/dry wet and ice have ordered traction limits
tires/unloaded wheel clears contact force and relaxation history
tires/relaxation is independent of step partition for constant contact
tires/nonpositive integration step is rejected
suspension/static sag supports configured axle weight
suspension/bump stop increases tangent stiffness near travel limit
suspension/no compression or velocity supplies no support
suspension/increasing compression increases static support
suspension/damping opposes compression and rebound motion
suspension/rapid rebound cannot produce tensile contact
suspension/antiroll force is antisymmetric and absent in heave
powertrain/torque curve interpolates its engineering data
powertrain/gear change interrupts torque for shift duration
powertrain/gearbox losses cannot add transmitted power
powertrain/out-of-range gears are rejected
powertrain/neutral disconnects wheel torque
powertrain/forward and reverse gears deliver opposite torque
powertrain/switched off engine provides no drive torque
powertrain/destroyed engine cannot provide normal power
damage/zero-energy contact causes no deformation
damage/plastic work never exceeds available impact energy
damage/larger impact produces at least as much plastic work
damage/distant contact does not deform unrelated body structure
damage/repeated impacts cannot exceed node deformation bounds
damage/opposite impacts cannot erase plastic work or repair nodes
damage/reset restores pristine structural state
saves/checksummed UTF8 payload round trips exactly
saves/backup rotates to immediately previous valid write
saves/payload checksum detects corruption despite valid envelope
saves/both corrupt copies fail safely
saves/writing after corruption preserves last good backup
saves/oversized writes reject without damaging existing data
saves/oversized on-disk primary is rejected with backup recovery
saves/missing save returns null and empty valid payload is preserved
coupled bench/neutral resting wheels cannot spontaneously accelerate
coupled bench/coasting dissipates translational energy
coupled bench/launch accelerates with bounded wheel reaction torque
coupled bench/60Hz and 120Hz retain similar launch response
coupled bench/reverse drivetrain drives negative translation
coupled bench/ice requires longer locked-wheel stop than dry asphalt
